name: progress
title: Progress
description: Thin linear progress bar: determinate with a smooth width transition, or the two-bar indeterminate loop.
improvements: role="progressbar" with aria-valuemin, aria-valuemax and aria-valuenow (omitted while indeterminate) and a label.
Values are clamped and can use any min/max range, with optional aria-valuetext.
The indeterminate animation turns into a slow single sweep for users who prefer reduced motion.
Track and bar colors follow the theme and dark mode.
